verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a library driven entirely through its public JavaScript/TypeScript API. That API is documented in a TypeDoc class reference (e.g. NullEngine), typed for full IntelliSense, published as NPM packages (@babylonjs/core 9.26.1), and can run headless on the server via NullEngine, so an agent can script it programmatically. Community reports independently praise its documentation and backward-compatible API, and the missing OpenAPI spec is irrelevant because this is not an HTTP service. Missing for 10: machine-friendly docs (pages are client-rendered with no .md mirrors, though llms.txt exists), and deeper evidence of API reference coverage beyond a single TypeDoc class page.
